description.value:
Life has been hard since your aberrant dragonmark appeared. Perhaps you hid it for most of your life or simply escaped notice. Or perhaps you met suspicion and fear, even open hostility from one or more of the dragonmarked houses. You might have joined House Tarkanan, the criminal organization named after one of the most infamous leaders of the aberrant-marked during the War of the Mark twenty-five centuries ago. Or you might be trying to find your own way, relying on your wits and the power of your mark.

Ability Scores: Strength, Constitution, Charisma

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.backgrounds-feats.Item.in0q7hagrXuI8byd]{Aberrant Dragonmark}

Skill Proficiencies: History and Intimidation

Tool Proficiency: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulDisguiseKi]{Disguise Kit}

Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepDagger0000]{Dagger}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulDisguiseKi]{Disguise Kit}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagCostume0000]{Costume}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesTrav]{Traveler's Clothes}, 16 GP; or (B) 50 GP
